desc:
🚔 RUN A POLICE STATION 🚨
Build. Command. Protect.
🏙️ Your city. Your police force. Your empire!
Start with a small police station and build your way into a powerful law enforcement empire! Hire officers, collect police vehicles, respond to emergencies, and expand your department across a living city!
🚨 RESPOND to robberies, accidents, and dangerous emergencies!
🚓 COLLECT & UPGRADE police cars, SUVs, tactical vans, and armored vehicles!
🏢 EXPAND your headquarters through 6 station tiers!
👮 HIRE & TRAIN officers with unique skills and abilities!
⚡ UNLOCK DIVISIONS!
💰 EARN & GROW by completing dispatch calls and building your police empire!
🏆 COMPLETE MISSIONS and work your way to the top!
🔥 From a small police station to a massive law enforcement operation — how big can YOU build your empire?
🚔 Build. Command. Protect.
